title: Q3 Platform Reliability Report
subtitle: Production Latency, Availability & Edge Delivery
takeaway: Edge routing kept global P95 latency under 65 ms while scaling traffic by 31%.
cta: Full telemetry dashboard available at status.northstar.internal

captions.text: Platform reliability reached 99.98% across production clusters in Q3.
P95 latency dropped 18 percent as daily volume climbed to 148 million requests.
US-East and EU-Central edge nodes maintained sub-45 ms response times.
Q4 roadmap automates multi-region failover under 15 seconds.
